WARN  lint-spa-poll-no-recovery  @DIR@/src/rc/index.html:20  setInterval/setTimeout poll loop 'poll()' reloads, but the recovery is not keyed on time since the last success (no lastOk* timestamp set from a clock in the poll body and compared) -- a failure-count or reload-on-error watchdog is blind to a hung request; key it on lastOkAt (types/dashboard.md Poll loop reliability)

-- src/rc/index.html --
<script>
let _wdFailCount = 0;
function _wdProbe() {
  fetch(location.href, { method: "GET" }).then(function (r) {
    if (r.ok) { location.reload(); }
  });
}
async function poll() {
  try {
    await readJson();
    _wdFailCount = 0;
    paint("live");
  } catch (err) {
    _wdFailCount++;
    if (_wdFailCount >= 6) { _wdProbe(); }
    paint("error");
  }
}
poll();
setInterval(poll, N4.pollMs);
</script>
